name: Locust Swarm
description: A swarm of bugs that get into every nook and cranny of the battlefield. They're constant bugging just makes the conditions everyone is fighting in worse.
effect:
- Bug-Types gain +1 Base Dexterity.
- Support Moves used by Bug, Poison, and Grass-Types deal damage equal to half their Rank Bonus (rounded up) if they target their opponent(s). For Support Moves which affect multiple opponents the User chooses 1 target to receive the damage.
- Deals Bug Type Damage to each Pokemon at the end of Each Round equal to Half the Round Timer of the Weather (rounded up). This is resisted by Defense and affected by all the normal Resistance rules. Bug-Types treat this damage as Ineffective (regardless of their normal type efficiency).
